events.description: List of input event device paths (e.g., `/dev/input/event0`) to monitor for IR events. Leave empty to auto-detect devices. Used to populate the EVENTS variable (space-separated). If empty or omitted, defaults to '/dev/input/event*' for backwards compatibility with shipped defaults.

options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to the `inputlirc` daemon (e.g., `--debug --dry-run`).
